title: For each year, calculate the percentage of films that had exclusively femal
question: For each year, calculate the percentage of films that had exclusively female actors (meaning no male actors and no actors with unknown/unspecified gender). Consider actors with gender marked as 'Male' or 'None' as non-female. For the results, display the year, the total number of movies in that year, and the percentage of movies with exclusively female actors. Extract the year from the Movie.year field by taking the last 4 characters and converting to a number.

prediction.sql:
WITH movie_year AS (
  SELECT MID, CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM Movie
),
non_female_movies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.MID
  FROM M_Cast c
  JOIN Person p ON p.PID = c.PID
  WHERE p.Gender <> 'Female'
)
SELECT m.yr AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN nf.MID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_excl_female
FROM movie_year m
LEFT JOIN non_female_movies nf ON nf.MID = m.MID
GROUP BY m.yr
ORDER BY m.yr

arguments.sql:
WITH movie_year AS (
  SELECT MID, CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM Movie
),
movie_flags AS (
  SELECT m.MID, m.yr,
         CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM M_Cast c JOIN Person p ON p.PID = c.PID
             WHERE c.MID = m.MID AND p.Gender <> 'Female'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_excl_female
  FROM movie_year m
)
SELECT yr AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_excl_female) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_excl_female
FROM movie_flags
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH movie_year AS (
  SELECT MID, CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM Movie
),
movie_actors AS (
  SELECT m.MID, p.Gender
  FROM movie_year m
  JOIN M_Cast c ON c.MID = m.MID
  JOIN Person p ON p.PID = c.PID
),
movie_flags AS (
  SELECT m.MID, m.yr,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_excl_female
  FROM movie_year m
  LEFT JOIN movie_actors p ON p.MID = m.MID
  GROUP BY m.MID, m.yr
)
SELECT yr AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_excl_female) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_excl_female
FROM movie_flags
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr
